{{Top}}
{{Quote|She's murder on holocubes, that's for sure-not that we've got anything worth putting on one.|Han Solo referring to Viqi Shesh|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Recovery">''[[The New Jedi Order: Recovery]]''</ref>}}
The '''holocube''' was a hand-sized, six-sided object designed to hold three-dimensional [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] images. By moving around the cube, a person could see all aspects of a displayed image. Holocubes also partially acted as deeds to [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] deed to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].
[[File:Tatooine_ghost_illustration_scene.jpg|thumb|211x211px|An undercover Leia views a holocube of her father as a little boy.]]
Souvenir holocubes, displaying images of tourist attractions were often sold to visitors such as on the planet [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar]].<ref name="GG:FFTR">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> [[Entertainment holocube]]s were also available; during a mission to monitor [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] communications on [[Iyuta]], [[Green squad]] were issued with extra entertainment holocubes.<ref name="Missing">{{WEGCite|story=Lens Reekeene Is Missing|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and Han Solo encountered one on Tatooine that depicted Leia's father [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after he had won the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
